rules_dir.description: Base directory for rule files (suricata.rules, local.rules, etc.)

rule_files.description: List of rule files to load (relative to rules_dir or absolute paths)

classification_file.description: Path to classification.config defining rule priority levels

reference_file.description: Path to reference.config defining external references for rules

log_dir.description: Base directory for Suricata logs (eve.json, fast.log, unified2.alert, etc.)

enable_json_log.description: Use modern JSON (EVE) logging instead of legacy formats like unified2

networks.description: Named address groups used in rules (e.g., HOME_NET, EXTERNAL_NET). Keys: group names; values: lists of CIDR or IP

ports.description: Named port groups used in rules (e.g., HTTP_PORTS, SSH_PORTS). Keys: group names; values: lists of port numbers

interfaces.description: List of interfaces to monitor in IPS/IDS mode. Each entry describes an af-packet interface

cluster_id.description: Cluster ID for load balancing (0 disables)

use_mmap.description: Enable memory-mapped ring buffers for performance

tpacket_v3.description: Enable TPACKET_V3 support for zero-copy capture

vlan.description: VLAN configuration (used for tracking and rule matching)

flow.description: Flow tracking settings: memory limits, hash size, preallocation, and session timeouts

app_layer.description: Application-layer protocol parsing and limits. Keys: protocol names; values: settings object

pcap.description: Pcap fallback capture mode (fallback if af-packet not used)

lua_scripts.description: Lua scripts to load (for custom protocol analysis, post-processing, etc.)

nfq.description: Netfilter queue (NFQ) settings for inline IPS mode. Set `queue_id` to enable

nflog.description: NFLOG settings for passive logging via NFLOG netlink

bpf_filter.description: BPF filter to apply to all capture interfaces (e.g., 'host 192.168.1.1 and port 80')

advanced.description: Advanced runtime tuning: 'drop' or 'reject' on bad checksums
